# Hot and Cool HVAC

> Licensed heating, cooling, and plumbing company serving Calgary, Alberta and surrounding communities with 24/7 emergency support.

Hot and Cool HVAC provides furnace repair, furnace installation, furnace tune-ups, emergency heating support, air conditioning installation, air conditioning repair, air conditioning tune-ups, and a range of plumbing services including drain cleaning, hot water tank repair, tankless water heater installation and repair, water softener installation, water purification systems, sump pump installation, toilet repairs, Poly-B pipe replacement, Kitec in-floor heating replacement, and residential duct cleaning.

## Service area

Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, Chestermere, Strathmore, Canmore, and Nanton, Alberta.
